title: Korean-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled lamb kebabs marinated in a sweet and spicy Korean-inspired sauce, perfect for a keto meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chili flakes, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and olive oil.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the kebabs into thin strips and serve with your favorite sides.
Note: If using wooden skewers, be sure to soak them in water for 30 minutes before grilling to prevent them from catching fire.
